title: Partner Rate Card: Interior Service Basis by Vehicle and Seats
content:
**Rule.** For a Wayfare partner detailer's work order on a Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning report, the service basis — the price of the interior service on the work order — is worked out from the reported trip: a three-row ride option (Wayfare XL or Wayfare Black SUV) with five or more seats requested is priced per seat row, that is the level's row price for each of the three seat rows; a three-row ride option with four or fewer seats requested, or a premium two-row option (Wayfare Comfort or Wayfare Black), is priced as the standard interior package plus one row price; any other trip is priced as the standard interior package.

Priced per seat row, the interior package is not used. The ride option and seats requested come from the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares); the level is the fee level the assessment holds.

## Rate card figures

| Fee level held | Standard interior package | Row price | Seat rows priced on a full three-row cabin |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor) | $45.00 | $20.00 | 3 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | $85.00 | $35.00 | 3 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | $140.00 | $55.00 | 3 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | $210.00 | $80.00 | 3 |

## Method by vehicle

| Ride option and seats requested | Service basis |
|---|---|
| Wayfare XL or Wayfare Black SUV, 5 or more seats | row price multiplied by 3 seat rows |
| Wayfare XL or Wayfare Black SUV, 4 or fewer seats | interior package plus one row price |
| Wayfare Comfort or Wayfare Black, any seats | interior package plus one row price |
| any other ride option | interior package |

## The resulting service basis by level

| Fee level held | Per seat row (three rows) | Package plus one row | Package |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor) | $60.00 | $65.00 | $45.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | $105.00 | $120.00 | $85.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | $165.00 | $195.00 | $140.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | $240.00 | $290.00 | $210.00 |

**Seat boundary (hypothetical).** A Level 3 work order on a Wayfare XL trip for 4 seats has a service basis of $195.00; the same order on a Wayfare XL trip for 5 seats has $165.00.
